name: Legends of Azamar
description:
About This Game

Legends of Azamar is a fast-paced action RPG focused on loot, dungeon crawling, and visceral combat. Answer the call of Bar-Ulduun, an ancient dwarven city of legend. Driven by glory, treasure, or duty, descend into the depths, battle deadly foes, and uncover the secrets that lie below.

Classes

Battle through the depths as the mighty Warrior, the cunning Rogue, or the enigmatic Mage, each wielding unique weapons, abilities, and play styles. Adapt, experiment, and uncover the legends buried deep within!

Dungeon Crawling Action

Legends of Azamar is an ARPG condensed to its core. Descend, fight, loot, return to camp, and repeat. Face increasingly deadly challenges as you push deeper, growing stronger with each expedition, culminating in challenging boss fights!

Replayability

Do you have the courage to face Bar-Ulduun's ever-shifting depths? Each expedition will never be the same with procedurally generated dungeons, dynamic paths, quests, and unique items to collect.

Choose your Path

Build your character with legendary equipment, powerful passives, and devastating abilities. Shape your path with multiple unique passive skill trees, each offering new avenues of character customisation. Will you become an unbreakable juggernaut by following the path of the Tower? Or embrace the Serpent’s cunning, and strike with lethal poisons? Or will you walk your own path?
short_desc: Step into the world of Avendor and brave the ruins of Bar-Ulduun, the fabled lost city of the dwarves. Descend into ever-shifting depths, grow in power, and claim legendary loot as you uncover the legends of Azamar in this visceral loot-driven action RPG.
